scope: UI-06 authorized audit identity names and optional list/card audit columns; protected calculation foundation remains in place
implementation: Tenant-owned internal name-only RPC, with explicit service scope, tenant/member/department lifecycle predicates and bounded batches.
APP decorates only authorized list/detail/approval responses; hidden/masked identities do not trigger lookups. Original IDs remain in storage, query/sort and immutable snapshots.
Shared name renderer for platform tables/cards and read-only form metadata; missing references return an explicit unavailable label.
Optional audit columns remain hidden by default and can be selected in platform column settings. Personal preferences cannot revive server-excluded fields.
Business cards use authorized business text fields, following configured list order, as their titles; record state is shown separately.
